skill.name: ai-avatar-video
skill.description: Create talking-head, lip-sync, character, and cinematic avatar videos through the RunComfy CLI. The skill selects a compatible model and prepares model-specific inputs and prompts.
skill.summary: Route avatar video requests to suitable RunComfy models and prepare focused generation instructions.
skill.author: agentspace-so

security_audit.summary: Most alerts are false positives caused by Markdown backticks, documentation links, placeholder URLs, model guidance, and standard token-storage documentation. Three findings remain confirmed because the skill recommends unpinned global npm or npx execution. A separate high-severity issue exists where user-derived content can break single-quoted shell arguments before the CLI receives them.

remediation.issue: User-derived prompts and URLs are embedded in single-quoted shell arguments.
remediation.suggestion: Pass serialized input through a file or standard input. Otherwise, use a shell-safe argument API and test apostrophes and shell metacharacters.

remediation.issue: Installation examples execute unpinned packages and mutable repository content.
remediation.suggestion: Pin exact package versions and an immutable commit. Remove automatic confirmation, avoid global installation, and require explicit user approval.

remediation.issue: The stated Bash scope conflicts with npm and npx commands elsewhere in the skill.
remediation.suggestion: Label installation as a manual prerequisite and remove executable installer instructions from the agent workflow. Keep runtime commands within the declared scope.

content.user_title: Create AI Avatar Videos with RunComfy
content.value_statement: Producing convincing avatar video requires selecting compatible models, inputs, and prompts. This skill routes each request and prepares RunComfy CLI commands for talking heads, lip sync, and cinematic presenters.
actual_capabilities: Routes requests across OmniHuman, Wan 2-7, Wan 2-2 Animate, HappyHorse 1.0, and Seedance v2 Pro.
Builds RunComfy CLI invocations for portrait, audio, prompt, duration, resolution, and aspect ratio inputs.
Supports audio-driven portraits, script-driven speech, stylized character animation, and multimodal cinematic shots.
Provides model-specific prompting guidance for speech, emotion, camera movement, lighting, and reference assets.
Explains CLI exit codes, output downloads, authentication, consent requirements, and common troubleshooting paths.
limitations: Requires the RunComfy CLI, a RunComfy account, network access, and available API credits.
Sends prompts and referenced media to an external generation service, using URLs that the service can access.
Does not verify identity, likeness rights, voice rights, or consent for supplied media.
Output quality, timing, lip synchronization, model availability, and input schemas can change across service versions.

use_cases.title: Produce Product Presenter Clips
use_cases.description: Create short portrait-led product videos from approved voiceovers and brand imagery.

use_cases.title: Localize Presenter Content
use_cases.description: Reuse one approved portrait with separate audio tracks for multiple language versions.

use_cases.title: Animate Illustrated Characters
use_cases.description: Pair a mascot or illustrated character with dialogue and synchronized full-body movement.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Talking Head
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a talking-head video from portrait [image URL] and voiceover [audio URL]. Choose the simplest suitable model and explain required inputs.

prompt_templates.title: Generate Speech from a Script
prompt_templates.prompt: Turn this script into a six-second vertical presenter video: [script]. Use a friendly tone, neutral background, and direct eye contact.

prompt_templates.title: Animate a Stylized Character
prompt_templates.prompt: Animate [character image URL] with [audio URL]. Preserve the illustrated style, synchronize full-body motion, and select the best character model.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Cinematic Monologue
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a cinematic monologue using [subject image], [voiceover], and [scene references]. Specify model, duration, aspect ratio, camera movement, lighting, and fallback route.

output_examples.input: Make this portrait speak using my eight-second voiceover.
output: Selected route: OmniHuman for a direct portrait-and-audio talking head.
Inputs requested: reachable portrait and voiceover URLs.
Result plan: eight-second generation saved to the selected output directory.

output_examples.input: Create a vertical presenter clip from this script without an audio file.
output: Selected route: HappyHorse text-to-video because speech must be generated.
Prompt plan: quote the exact dialogue and request direct eye contact.
Format plan: vertical aspect ratio with a short duration.

output_examples.input: Animate our illustrated mascot with the approved narration.
output: Selected route: Wan 2-2 Animate for a stylized character.
Inputs requested: mascot image and narration URLs.
Motion plan: preserve the illustration while synchronizing speech and body movement.

best_practices: Obtain documented consent and usage rights for every face, voice, image, and audio source.
Use clean speech audio, clear portraits, short scripts, and model-appropriate framing.
Review the current model schema, expected cost, privacy terms, and generated video before publication.
anti_patterns: Do not imitate real people or clone voices without explicit, verifiable consent.
Do not place untrusted user text directly into shell command strings.
Do not use a complex cinematic model for a basic portrait-and-audio request.

faq.question: What do I need before using this skill?
faq.answer: You need the RunComfy CLI, an authenticated account, network access, and accessible input media.

faq.question: Can I start with only a written script?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill can route script-only requests to HappyHorse, which generates speech during video creation.

faq.question: Which model uses my exact audio track?
faq.answer: OmniHuman and Wan audio-driven routes accept supplied audio. The best choice depends on portrait simplicity and scene control.

faq.question: Can it animate illustrated characters?
faq.answer: Yes. Wan 2-2 Animate is the documented route for illustrated, anime, or mascot subjects.

faq.question: Where are my prompts and media processed?
faq.answer: RunComfy processes the generation request and fetches referenced media URLs. Review its current privacy and retention terms before using sensitive assets.

faq.question: Does the skill guarantee accurate lip synchronization?
faq.answer: No. Results vary with audio quality, portrait framing, selected model, service changes, and generation randomness.
